parameters.apprise_url_plus: napi://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.client_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.client_secret_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-notificationapi` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your NotificationAPI destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional NotificationAPI destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"type":"apprise","user":{"id":{* _escape_json(_body.title or "notify") *}},"message":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(( (_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="" ) and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment NotificationAPI destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to NotificationAPI sender endpoint
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own NotificationAPI destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

client_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NotificationAPI client id

client_secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NotificationAPI client secret

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NotificationAPI targets
